groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.751% and the 10Y at 5.100%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 7 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -3.80% over five sessions and -1.67% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -1.20% at about $104.79, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-30/100, 67% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is falling oil on the supportive side versus weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.100%, semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
